id: D72-01 (on/off settings as true/false; the words before 0.1.6, settings set, settings migrate, the status warning, the hidden keys)
note: D-72 (0.1.6; owner 2026-11-08: two-value settings as true/false, with a /config screen that shows the description): the seven on/off keys are userConfig strings with options ["true", "false"] (a picker in /config); relaunch_auto, idle_handoff_near_limit and idle_digest list their words. settings.pm %SWITCH reads true/false and every word a release before 0.1.6 saved as before (halt, model, shadow, allow, auto as true; off, code, forbid, confirm as false; another case, spaces, a JSON boolean), never as the opposite, and config.ts SWITCH is the same table (gate). Claude Code reads a saved value outside the options as unset, so status and settings show warn about such a value with the migrate command (consent keys apart: the plugin never writes one); settings set takes an old word and writes true or false; settings migrate is a dry run, --apply rewrites through the settings writer (backup, --plan), a value equal to its default is removed, consent keys are only listed with their user-run lines; resume_proceed stays tighten-only. otel_log_path and restart_on_update are not in the built manifest (they do nothing yet) but the helper still reads a saved restart_on_update. An old form from the environment gets a note.
